newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates drop to close at 22.125 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates drop to close at 22.125 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates were back on Monday to what traders consider "normal" levels of around the one-week reverse repo standing at 22.25 perent.
Overnight rates finished at 22.125 percent after being traded between 22.125 to 22.75 percent, compared with Friday's close of 28 percent.
"Friday's surge was caused by position misjudgement rather than an illiquid market," said Sandor Tolonics of Budapest Bank.
O/N rates are back on track at the start of the banks' reserve period, he said. -- Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
